fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Once-Through Supercritical Rankine Cycle with Evaporator Thermal ODE
description: Pulverized-coal combustion feeding a supercritical (>221 bar) / ultra-supercritical (~600 C) once-through Rankine cycle with double reheat and regenerative feedwater heating. Steam-side enthalpies from simplified IAPWS-IF97-style correlations (hardcoded, cited). Lumped once-through evaporator thermal transient solved with scipy.solve_ivp.
source: Weitzel, P.S. (2011), ASME PVP-2011-57934; IAPWS-IF97 (Wagner & Kretzschmar 2008, Int. Steam Tables, Springer); Spliethoff (2010), Power Generation from Solid Fuels, Springer; IEA Clean Coal Centre CCC/168 (2010); Luo, Z. et al. (2013) Energy, 57, 236-244.

unit.name: Generic 800 MW Ultra-Supercritical PC Plant (600 C / 250 bar, double reheat)

P_boiler_bar.note: Main steam / once-through evaporator pressure (>221 bar supercritical). SC ~250, USC up to ~300

T_main_steam_c.note: Superheater outlet / HP turbine inlet temperature. SC ~565-600, USC up to ~620

T_reheat_c.note: Reheat steam temperature (double reheat returns steam to this T)

P_reheat1_bar.note: First reheat pressure (HP turbine exhaust / cold reheat)

P_reheat2_bar.note: Second reheat pressure (IP turbine exhaust) for double-reheat USC

eta_turbine_isentropic.note: Turbine isentropic efficiency, advanced steam path (Spliethoff 2010)

eta_boiler.note: Boiler/combustion efficiency (fraction of coal LHV transferred to working fluid; balance is stack + radiation loss)

fw_heating_fraction.note: Fraction of turbine steam bled for regenerative feedwater heating; raises mean heat-addition temperature (Carnotization)

T_feedwater_c.note: Final feedwater temperature after regenerative heating (high for SC/USC)

aux_power_fraction.note: House/auxiliary load fraction (mills, fans, BFP) subtracted from gross to give net

LHV_coal.note: Bituminous coal lower heating value (Spliethoff 2010 typical range 24-27 MJ/kg)

m_evap_metal_kg.note: Lumped once-through evaporator + waterwall metal mass (thermal inertia)

cp_metal_kj_kgK.note: Specific heat of ferritic/martensitic boiler steel (P91/P92)

m_fluid_evap_kg.note: Lumped supercritical-water inventory in evaporator section

cp_fluid_kj_kgK.note: Effective pseudo-cp of supercritical water near pseudocritical region (elevated vs subcritical liquid ~5)

hA_evap_MW_K.note: Lumped flue-gas to evaporator-fluid conductance (overall UA)

T_flame_c.note: Adiabatic-ish furnace gas temperature seen by evaporator (PC flame ~1300-1600 C)

eta_net_subcritical.note: Typical modern subcritical PC net LHV efficiency (~37-39%); SC/USC must exceed this

subcritical_reference.note: Used by tests to enforce net_eff(USC) > subcritical reference.

P_boiler_bar.note: Supercritical: above water critical pressure 220.6 bar
